title: Admin-managed 5% promo codes with checkout discount UI and admin promo visibility

requirements.summary: Add an admin Promo Codes section to list/add/remove promo codes with loading and error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Dashboard includes a new tab/section labeled "Promo Codes" (English).
Admins can enter a promo code and save it; the list updates without a full page reload.
Admins can remove/deactivate a promo code from the list; the list updates after the action.
UI shows loading and error states for promo code operations.

file_operations.description: Create an admin-only PromoCodesSection UI that uses React Query promo-code hooks to render the current promo code list, add form, and remove/deactivate actions, including loading, empty, and error states. Use the authorization component/system to ensure only admins can access admin features (app already uses AdminGate); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire PromoCodesSection into the existing Admin Dashboard by adding a new TabsTrigger labeled "Promo Codes" and a corresponding TabsContent rendering the section within the admin styling/layout. Use the authorization component/system via the existing admin route gating patterns to keep this section admin-only; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add optional promo code input to checkout, apply 5% discount on valid code, and submit promo code with order creation.
acceptanceCriteria: New Order page includes a "Promo code" input (optional).
When a valid promo code is entered, the pricing summary reflects a 5% discount and updates the displayed total accordingly.
When an invalid promo code is entered, the UI clearly indicates the code is invalid and does not apply the discount.
On successful order creation with a promo code, the promo code value is included in the order creation call and is visible later on the order data returned from the backend.

file_operations.description: Add a new optional "Promo code" input to the order form, include inline validation messaging (valid/invalid/loading), and update the pricing summary to apply an additional 5% off when the entered code validates. Ensure the computed total reflects the promo discount when valid and does not discount when invalid.

Add a React Query-based hook that validates a user-entered promo code by fetching the configured promo codes from the backend actor and performing normalization (trim + case-insensitive match) client-side, returning states suitable for the New Order UI (loading/valid/invalid/error).

Extend the create order mutation to accept an optional promoCode and pass it through to the backend order creation call (send null when empty). Preserve current behavior for no promo code, and surface backend invalid-promo errors so NewOrderPage can show a clear message.
Update error normalization to map the backend invalid-promo error into a clear English message that the promo code is invalid, suitable for display in the New Order page.

requirements.summary: Show promo usage on admin order views (list and/or detail) as 'No promo' or the applied promo code.
acceptanceCriteria: In the admin orders list and/or order detail surfaces already present in the admin panel, each order shows promo usage: either "No promo" or the promo code string used.
The display remains readable and consistent with the existing admin styling.

file_operations.description: Update the admin orders list rendering to display promo usage per order using the existing order fields (promoUsed and promoCode), showing either "No promo" or the promo code string in a readable, style-consistent way (e.g., a small label/badge in each order card row). Use the authorization component/system via existing AdminGate patterns for admin-only visibility; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks and stable query keys for promo code admin list/add/remove operations with proper invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: Promo code list is fetched via a dedicated React Query query with a stable query key.
After add/remove/deactivate promo code mutations succeed, the promo code list query is invalidated and refetched.
No edits are made to frontend immutable paths (per project constraints).

file_operations.description: Add stable promo-code-related query keys (e.g., promoKeys.list()) to the centralized query key file so promo list and mutations can reliably invalidate/refetch without collisions.

Create React Query hooks for admin promo code operations: list promo codes (query) plus add/remove (mutations), using the backend actor methods for promo codes and invalidating the promo list query on mutation success.
